title: Blank project
description: An empty scene to start from.

title: Area under a curve
description: Rectangles shrink toward the exact area, then the area function reveals dA/dx = f(x). 3 scenes, inspired by Essence of Calculus.

title: Fourier series: a square wave from sines
description: Add sine waves one by one, then watch spinning circles draw the wave. 2 scenes, inspired by “But what is a Fourier series?”

title: Linear transformations
description: Basis vectors, a shear, a rotation and the determinant as area. 4 scenes, inspired by Essence of Linear Algebra.

title: The quadratic formula, derived
description: Complete the square step by step, then check the formula on a parabola's roots. 3 scenes (MathTex).

title: Euler's formula: e^iπ = −1
description: Multiplying by i as a quarter turn, then e^iθ walking the unit circle. 2 scenes.

title: Taylor series of sin(x)
description: Polynomials of growing degree hug the sine curve over a wider range. 2 scenes.

title: Pythagorean theorem, by rearrangement
description: The same four triangles in one square, arranged two ways. 2 scenes.

title: Functions of two variables
description: A surface rises from the plane with an orbiting camera, then a moving slice turns it into a 1D graph. 2 scenes, 3D.

title: Bayes' theorem as areas
description: Librarian or farmer? Prior odds and evidence drawn as areas. 4 scenes, inspired by 3Blue1Brown's Bayes video.

title: Central limit theorem
description: Averages of more and more dice pile up into a bell curve. 2 scenes.

title: Estimating π with random darts
description: Why the share of darts inside a quarter circle is π/4, then 1,200 throws with a live estimate. 2 scenes.

title: How a neural network makes a guess
description: Layers and weights, the maths inside one neuron, then a forward pass that picks a label. 3 scenes.

title: Gradient descent
description: A ball steps downhill along the slope, then three learning rates race: too small, too big, about right. 2 scenes.

title: Bubble sort vs merge sort
description: Neighbour swaps against split-and-merge on the same list, with comparisons counted. 3 scenes.

title: Breadth-first vs depth-first search
description: The same graph searched with a queue, then a stack, with the visit order written out. 2 scenes.

title: Binary search
description: L, M and R pointers halve the range until the target is found. Edit the list and target. 2 scenes.
